column1: # Programs that the shipped units, helpers and settings run and that only a
# package provides. rog5-build-rootfs (step finalize) fails when one is not
# an executable file in the built root, and test-rog5-build-rootfs.py checks
# that each package is in configs/rootfs/packages.txt (an optional
# dependency of another package, e.g. nftables of networkmanager, must be
# listed itself) or, marked dep:<package>, a hard dependency of one, and
# that the file named in USED-BY still runs the program.
# Columns are separated by one or more tabs.
